scope: The proposed exact full-day action-difference supervision using the passive v121/v127/v130 panel. Not all online RL or all dripping data.
correction: Full-day2W+R remains the evaluation objective. Exact full-day outcome availability is not a universal requirement for TD learning; it is a requirement only if this exact observed difference is used as the training label.
decision: Do not fit a standaloneR head, replace event reward with a long return while retaining the earlier bootstrap state, or relaunch an existing paired slope model. Retain v130 factual costs and FIFO as diagnostics.

conditional_cross_day_design.timing: Labels from a completed target day may be used only after24030 in an explicitly separate later target day; no reset of the clock can turn them into same-day feedback.
conditional_cross_day_design.supervision: Passive completed-day returns still do not provide both actions. Exact delta labels require separately budgeted same-state two-arm native simulation with one fixed frozen continuation, or a justified different causal identification design.
conditional_cross_day_design.unit: One root-action pair; passengers, repeated replays and multiple outcomes at one root are not independent root samples.
required_before_any_execution: One concrete service-state mechanism beyond the closed line/headway slope and departure-risk heads.
Outcome-blind root selection,actual original-F action rule,and independent development/evaluation panels.
Separate simulator label-generation cost from ordinary passive285 feedback and offline initialization.
A new proposal must explain which actual new information resolves prior failures; moving the day boundary alone does not.
conditional_cross_day_design.single_root_native_seconds: t+2*(24000-t)=48000-t when one prefix is shared and both suffixes are executed; this is accounting for a proposed paired label, not an approved total budget.

preserved.cost_gate: Complete four days and technical checks. fresh-minus-matched-no_fresh mean<0,stable<=0,shock<0; additionally fresh-minus-same-actor-frozen<=0 in each scenario and at least one<0. Report no_fresh-minus-frozen to distinguish baseline drift. Early and tail windows are descriptive, not new gates.
